name: Beken Corporation
summary: Beken Corporation engages in the research, development, and sale of wireless communication integrated circuit chips in China and internationally. It offers wireless data transmission products, including independent radio frequency receivers and transmitters; wireless microcontrollers with integrated microprocessors (MCUs); and an electronic toll collection (ETC) chip compliant with national standards.
